notes.title: Hop Into the Froggy Sale And Follow For New Updates! 🐸
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Toadled fans![/h2]
We’re thrilled to announce that Toadled Classic is part of the epic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44758638/sale/froggy-sale/?curator_clanid=4777282]Froggy Sale[/url], where you can snag the game at a discount alongside a bunch of other ridiculous, frog-themed adventures. Whether you’re hopping through classic toad chaos or checking out some new amphibious friends, this sale is the perfect excuse to dive back into the pond!

[h2]Why Stop There?[/h2]
We’ve got something even more exciting on the horizon for Toadled fans. While we can't say much yet, let's just say there’s a lot more eating, growing, and mayhem on the way. Keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates and a brand new take on your favorite hungry toad! 🐸✨ (Hint: early concept art included below 😉)

notes.title: Something New for Toadled?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/0c41f48debc39a658d225fb4543698c19dff17a1.png[/img]

Happy New Year to our Toadled community! 

With the new year, we've got some new ideas brewing for projects for 2023, and one of those relates to our beloved toad character. It's not a certain thing yet, but we are considering developing a Toadled board game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/28f19117f5d7417b507a1e5a77fa64e9a2c59612.png[/img]
[i]Note: Box art is not final! [/i]

With that said, we'd love to hear from you all! 
Would you play it? 
What would you expect to be included in the game mechanics? 
Anything you have been dying to see in a board game conversion from your favorite Steam game? 

Let us know!

notes.title: Giant Fox Studios Gives Some Backstory to its Most Popular Game: Toadled!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/0c41f48debc39a658d225fb4543698c19dff17a1.png[/img]

Giant Fox Studios isn’t just working on games, we have already released many as well! The most popular of all of them is our fun “clicker,” Toadled. It's a fast-paced game that is easy to learn but hard to master - our specialty.

Toadled has been played and viewed by millions…

[previewyoutube=crQ6RAm69Eg;full]HIGHEST FROG LEVEL POSSIBLE in Toadled![/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=rym78UPUDZk;full]Toadled Gameplay - One Toad to RULE ALL! (Toadled PC Gameplay Playthrough)[/previewyoutube]

 …but few know the truth behind our main character. 

Toadled starts with a common Texas Toad being abducted by aliens. These aliens poked and prodded the poor toad in an attempt to learn about animal species on Earth. The toad didn’t complain very much and so the aliens, appreciating the silence, decided to give the little toad 1 wish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/3b7ec1de86d4276d6bc97ff547c5e03c526cbcec.jpg[/img]

The Toad could only think of one thing: the ability to eat anything and everything they wanted, as the toad was quite hungry at the time. The aliens agreed and had their intern write up some DNA-altering code. They gave the toad a quick ZAP in the “krisper” and sent them back to Earth vowing to return some day with exotic flies from far-away planets for the Toad to sample.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26091007/fa5d826ae96a5894b3c5debd43af31b0e7cbcbfc.png[/img]

Then the Toad awoke and started eating. Everything changed and the universe was brought to its knees. What went wrong with Toad? Is it simply a bad line of code from a new alien programmer? Perhaps this was the intention, the end of all things? What do we really know of the Toads' motivations? 

Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/521630/Toadled/]Toadled on Steam[/url] to check it out for yourself!

notes.title: We are Back
notes.content:
New titles in the works and a complete Catalog sale. 

Hey Guys, 

It has been a while but we are back. 

With two titles in the works and a potential third, we are making another run to bring you sequels to the silly games which we all grew to love. 

There's Poop in my Soup 2 - in the works
Frisky Business 2 - in the works


This week we will be running a sale on the whole catalog, check it out below and pick up a game or two if they are missing from your K Bros catalog, there is something for everyone. 

Classics like There's Poop in my Soup, Super Duper Party pooper or Flix and Chill are always a laugh with friends. Albert and Otto was our first game and still very close to our hearts, if you have Albert and Otto then definitely check out Burn it Down as they are very similar yet so different. Tanks vs Aliens and Evil Glitch are awesome for blowing off some steam. 


I have linked all the pages below so you can check them out. 

Thanks for all your support, we look forward to bringing you more games!
